name: reborrow_mut
declaration: unsafe fn reborrow_mut (& mut self) -> NodeRef < marker :: Mut < '_ > , K , V , Type >
parent: NodeRef < marker :: Mut < 'a > , K , V , Type >
documentation:
Temporarily takes out another mutable reference to the same node. Beware, as
 this method is very dangerous, doubly so since it might not immediately appear
 dangerous.

 Because mutable pointers can roam anywhere around the tree, the returned
 pointer can easily be used to make the original pointer dangling, out of
 bounds, or invalid under stacked borrow rules.
rules: The returned mutable node reference must not be used in a way that makes the original node reference dangling.
The returned mutable node reference must not be used in a way that makes the original node reference out of bounds.
The returned mutable node reference must not be used in a way that makes the original node reference invalid under stacked borrow rules.
